backfill_evidence_only.description: policy-composition ticket 18: when "true", run the gate and commit signed evidence for the named policy/v* tag(s), but create no tag and push commits (not tags) straight to this branch instead -- for a version cut before the publisher gate (cs-27) existed, so it never got evidence. The gate computes against the REAL, already- committed distribution/policies/v<version> tree (build_current_subject reads real files, not the tag object itself), so this is a genuine, reproducible computation -- not a fabricated value -- generated today rather than at original release. Tags stay immutable; only evidence files are added.

tag.description: tag to verify + publish (workflow_dispatch path only)
